title: 'I suffered brain bleed and saw dad in afterlife – he said death isn't real'
excerpt: Vania Valtriani collapsed at a party after a stroke and brain bleed – but claims she had an extraordinary near death experience where she was reunited with her deceased father
content:
'My brain flooded with blood as I saw afterlife and dead dad – he said death isn't real'

Vania Valtriani collapsed at a party after a stroke and brain bleed – but claims she had an extraordinary near death experience where she was reunited with her deceased father

09:29, 18 Sep 2026

A woman who experienced a devastating brain bleed has described how she was taken to another dimension where her deceased father appeared alive – and he urged her to share a startling revelation. Vania Valtriani had been dancing at a party when, without warning, she experienced an excruciating pain in her head. Within moments, she had collapsed and was rushed to hospital.

‌

It turned out the then 45-year-old had suffered a stroke, accompanied by a serious brain bleed; and her husband, Sinecil, was informed that her chances of survival were slim.

‌

Vania, however, was oblivious to the discussions taking place around her and was, instead, transported to another dimension where she encountered her late father. And, when she finally came back, there was a crucial message she needed to deliver.

‌

"I kept being told that everything will be alright – and that death isn't the end to our story," the business administrator said.. "In fact, death isn't even real.

"My father – who passed 16 years [before my out-of-body experience] – was there right in front of me. He was alive; there's no doubt about it. When I saw him, he wasn't elderly or ill.

‌

"He appeared young and was surrounded by a beautiful light. I recall him looking the same as he did when I was only a child. His face had something about it that I had never seen on Earth; it was filled with peace, love and calm."

Vania's nightmare unfolded in 2014. She remembers the pain feeling as though a "knife had been twisted" in her head. With blood flooding into her brain, doctors warned her relatives to prepare their final farewells.

‌

She said: "The doctor returned after I had surgery and said I wouldn't survive; it was a given. The stroke's damage was as if I had fallen from a high height. I was placed on machines and remained in a coma for three days.

"But, while I was lying in hospital, I could see myself from outside of my body. Even though, when I looked down, the body lying there wasn't somebody I recognised."

After being transported to her father, the two communicated without words. Vania, who resides in Utah, US, said: "He opened his arms to me and told me to walk with him. All I could feel was a profound sense of love.

‌

"But I wasn't ready to leave. I had to say my second goodbyes to him as I agreed to go back to Earth. Then, he disappeared."

Before returning to her body, Vania understood that existing as a spirit meant feeling everything simultaneously – and seeing more than just meets the eye.

‌

The agony returned, this time more intense, as she was thrust back into her corporeal body. Upon opening her eyes, another figure stood waiting – and it wasn't her spouse.

She said: "He had two amazing dark eyes. It was almost like fire was inside of them. He had dark hair and was so tall. At first, I thought he was an angel, until he spoke in my brain rather than out loud – and he told me three things."

‌

Vania claims the man spoke about her son, Jonathan, and her husband, expressing how happy and pleased he was with their goodwill efforts and faithful natures.

He further revealed that the human body is merely temporary, and that life on Earth serves just one purpose: to provide the spirit with experiences, growth and learning.

‌

Without warning, he disappeared – and with him, her pain. Vania believes this was Jesus resurrecting her. Back in her own body, the person inhabiting it was changed.

She added: "My own family and friends didn't even recognise who I was anymore. My mum said the daughter she once knew disappeared that day. I couldn't even remember my native language – Portuguese – only English.

"I had to relearn it again. But I've come back with such a valuable lesson. Life is to be lived; your spirit needs it to survive. I was once afraid of dying and losing those around me.

"But your loved ones are never truly gone. You will see them again when they're alive and well in a different realm."
